name: Pakistan Affairs · Ancient & Muslim Rule (pre-1857)
title: Pakistan Affairs · Ancient & Muslim Rule (pre-1857)
subtitle: Practice bank topic · 45 MCQs
answerKeyNote: Practice answer key (not an official FPSC key). Keys were cross-checked and corrected where needed; items marked Low confidence are noted in the explanation.
source: https://pakjobmcqs.com/subjects/pakistan-studies (topic chapters: history, constitution, geography, economy, foreign relations, culture)
Key checks: na.gov.pk / Constitution Art. 51 (NA seats), Wikipedia & Gazette of India 17 Aug 1947 (Radcliffe Award), cabinet.gov.pk 1958 cabinet list (Bhutto as Commerce Minister)

questions.text: Excavations at Moen-jo-daro have revealed _________ in earthen vessels.
questions.explanation: Low confidence: CSS key reported as millet; excavation reports mention wheat, barley and other grains — treat as a past-paper recall item. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: Military strength of East India Company and the Financial Support of Jaggat Seth of Murshidabad gave birth to events at ___________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Plassey. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: Clive in one of his Gazettes made it mandatory that no Muslim shall be given an employment higher than that of chaprasy or a junior clerk has been recorded by ___________.
questions.explanation: Low confidence: obscure attribution carried from the CSS key. Source: CSS 2005 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2005/).

questions.text: The first Muslim general entered Victorious in the sub-continent Indo-Pak in the year ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 712 AD. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: Who became the first Sultan of newly established Muslim Sultanate of Delhi in 1207?
questions.explanation: Note: the Delhi Sultanate was founded in 1206; the paper says 1207. Source: CSS 2007 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2007/).

questions.text: Mahmud of Ghazni waged war against rebellious India in the year of ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1000 AD. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: Shahab-ud-Din Muhammad Ghuri defeated Pirthviraj in the year 1192 in the field of ___________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Tarori or Tarain. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: Qutb-ud-Din Aibak was succeeded on Delhi throne by ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Aram Shah. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: The downfall of Muslim rule in India started with the demise of _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Aurangzeb. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: The Holy Quran was first translated into Persian by _______.
questions.explanation: Answer: Shah Waliullah. Source: CSS 2008 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2008/).

questions.text: Who rejected the verdicts of jurists that idol worshipers are liable to be murdered?
questions.explanation: Answer: Shams-ud-Din Iltumish. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: Who constructed five canals to remove scarcity of water?
questions.explanation: Answer: Feroz Shah Tughlaq. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: Who laid foundation of Agra city?
questions.explanation: Answer: Sikandar Lodhi. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: Who accepted Akbar’s “Din-e-Illahi”?
questions.explanation: Answer: Birbal. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: Which office held supreme judicial authority during Mughal rule?
questions.explanation: Low confidence: the Emperor was the fountain of justice; Qazi-ul-Quzat headed the judiciary under him. Source: CSS 2009 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2009/).

questions.text: Name the saint, who first came in Lahore.
questions.explanation: Answer: Shaikh Ismail. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: Ghiyas-ud-din Balban declared himself king of Delhi Sultanate in the year _____.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1266. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: Who founded Daulatabad and shifted the capital of Delhi Sultanate?
questions.explanation: Answer: Muhammad Tughluq. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: Who set up the chain of justice to redress the grievances of oppressed people?
questions.explanation: Answer: Jahangir. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: Who was known in history as Mujaddid Alf Thani, the reformer of second millennium?
questions.explanation: Answer: Shaikh Ahmed Sirhindi. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: Who called the 'spiritual guide' as shopkeepers?
questions.explanation: Low confidence: attributed to Shah Waliullah's critique of hereditary pirs. Source: CSS 2010 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2010/).

questions.text: Who recalled Muhammad Bin Qasim from Sindh?
questions.explanation: Answer: Caliph Sulaiman. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: What was the real name Shah Wali Ullah?
questions.explanation: Answer: Qutubddin Ahmed Faruqi. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: Who was formal teacher of Syed Ahmed Barelvi?
questions.explanation: Answer: Shah Abdul Aziz. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: Who for the first time translated the Holy Quran in Urdu language?

options.A: Shah Walliullah and Shah Abdul Aziz
options.B: Shah Abdul Qadir and Shah Rafiuddin
options.C: Syed Ahmed Baralvi and Shah Ismail Dehlvi

questions.explanation: Answer: Shah Abdul Qadir and Shah Rafiuddin. Source: CSS 2011 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2011/).

questions.text: The Silsilah-i-Chishtiyah was founded in sub Continent by whom?
questions.explanation: Answer: Kh Muinud Din Ajmeri. Source: CSS 2012 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2012/).

questions.text: When Shah Wali Ullah died?
questions.explanation: Answer: 1762. Source: CSS 2012 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2012/).

questions.text: The Aryans arrived in South Asia in _______.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1500 BC. Source: CSS 2013 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2013/).

questions.text: The most ancient civilization is __________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Mehargarh. Source: CSS 2013 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2013/).

questions.text: Who was the Mughal Emperor who accepted the British pension firstly?
questions.explanation: Answer: Shah Alam-II. Source: CSS 2013 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2013/).

questions.text: Ahmad Shah Abdali launched his early invasions against __________.
questions.explanation: Low confidence: Abdali's early invasions (1748 onwards) were against the Mughal Empire. Source: CSS 2013 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2013/).

questions.text: The British fought Plassey war against __________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Sirajuddaula. Source: CSS 2013 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2013/).

questions.text: Dars-i-Nizami was named after ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Mullah Nizamuddin. Source: CSS 2013 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2013/).

questions.text: What was the Capital of Sindh during Mohammad Bin Qasim’s invasion?
questions.explanation: Answer: Alore (Rohri). Source: CSS 2014 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2014/).

questions.text: Sheikh Ahmad Sirhind was born at _________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Sirhind. Source: CSS 2014 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2014/).

questions.text: Hujjatullah ul Baligha was written by ____________.
questions.explanation: Answer: Shah Wali Ullah. Source: CSS 2015 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2015/).

questions.text: The Last Mughal: The Fall of a Dynasty, Delhi, 1857, was written by ________.
questions.explanation: Answer: William Dalrymple. Source: CSS 2016 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2016/).

questions.text: Which infamous law was passed by Lord Dalhousie?
questions.explanation: Answer: Doctrine of Lapse. Source: CSS 2016 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2016/).

questions.text: Mohenjo-daro was discovered in:
questions.explanation: Answer: 1922. Source: CSS 2017 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2017/).

questions.text: East India Company arrived in Surat in ______.
questions.explanation: Answer: 1608. Source: CSS 2019 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2019/).

questions.text: Shaikh Ahmad Sirhindi (Mujaddid Alif Sani) was born on ____________.
questions.explanation: Answer: 26 June 1564. Source: CSS 2020 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2020/).

questions.text: The East India Company was formed through the royal charter from Queen Elizabeth I on ________________.
questions.explanation: Answer: December 31, 1600 AD. Source: CSS 2021 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2021/).

questions.text: When was the rule of East India Company ended?
questions.explanation: Answer: 1858. Source: CSS 2022 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2022/).

questions.text: The First Battle of Panipat was fought between the invading forces of Babur and the Lodi Empire, which took place on?
questions.explanation: Answer: 21 APRIL 1526. Source: CSS 2022 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2022/).

questions.text: Who revolted against Akbar’s Deen-e-Ilahi for the first time?
questions.explanation: Answer: MUJADDID ALF SANI. Source: CSS 2022 Pakistan Affairs past paper (https://cssprep.com.pk/pakistan-affairs-mcqs-2022/).
